labels.description: Close-up cutout of Grumpy Cat (Tardar Sauce), a flat-faced Siamese-mix cat with dark brown and white markings, amber eyes heavily lidded in a downward scowl, and a pronounced frown. No visible text. White background.

labels.description: Cutout of a white cat photographed at a dinner table — the 'Woman Yelling at Cat' meme's cat half. Alone it works as self-deprecating humour for rationalising behaviour, arguing with yourself, or being confused by criticism. Ambiguous — could also read as simply bewildered.

labels.description: Cutout of a white and orange tabby cat with very large, glossy, teary eyes giving a thumbs-up with one paw raised. The cat looks genuinely sad or overwhelmed despite the positive gesture. No visible text. Transparent/white background.
labels.emotion: sad but supportive, bravely okay, emotionally conflicted
labels.meaning: Classic 'I'm fine' or 'everything is fine' irony meme — outwardly signalling okay while clearly distressed. Useful for relatable humour around masking emotions, pushing through a hard day, or performing wellness. In DBT contexts can gently illustrate the gap between how we present and how we feel, without diagnosing.

labels.description: Cutout of a chunky orange and white cat seated upright, wearing large dark wraparound sunglasses and appearing to adjust them with one paw. Expression is calm and self-satisfied. No visible text. White/transparent background.
labels.emotion: cool, smug, unbothered, self-assured
labels.meaning: Represents effortless confidence, not caring what others think, or 'deal with it' energy. Works as a reaction to successfully handling a situation, practising a DBT skill smoothly, or embodying radical acceptance with style. Can also signal lighthearted smugness after a win.

labels.description: Close-up of a white short-haired cat with visible tears streaming down both cheeks, mouth closed, sitting upright against a transparent/white background. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Sad, tearful, quietly devastated — despite the filename suggesting surprise, the dominant expression is clearly crying/sorrowful
labels.meaning: Classic 'crying cat' meme used to express genuine or exaggerated sadness, emotional overwhelm, or relatable heartbreak. Works as a reaction to disappointing news, rejection, or 'this hits too close to home' moments. Ambiguous note: filename says 'surprised' but the image shows no surprise markers — tears are the defining feature.

labels.description: Extreme close-up selfie-angle of a white cat with blue-grey eyes, looking upward and slightly to the side with a subtly smug, calculating expression. Mouth closed. No visible text. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: Smug, sly, quietly plotting — a low-key scheming or 'I know something you don't' look
labels.meaning: Functions as a reaction for passive scheming, barely concealed self-satisfaction, or the moment before executing a sneaky plan. Good for 'me pretending to be fine while actually plotting' or 'using a DBT skill... reluctantly' jokes.

labels.description: Close-up of a grey tabby cat with amber/green eyes, tongue visibly sticking out in a blep, with a slightly wild asymmetric gaze. White background. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Cheeky, goofy, irreverent — a playful 'pfft' or 'whatever' energy
labels.meaning: Ideal reaction for dismissing something absurd, expressing light rebellion, or punctuating a joke with irreverence. The blep tongue adds goofiness over aggression. Suits 'me when someone tells me to just think positive' or silly self-deprecating moments.

labels.description: Orange tabby cat photographed at extreme close selfie distance, face filling the frame, front paws stretched toward the camera, wearing a wide toothy grin with large dilated eyes. Slightly blurry due to proximity. White background. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Chaotically enthusiastic, manic grin, over-eager — intense happiness verging on unhinged
labels.meaning: Perfect for 'too much energy', hyperfocus, or the moment a plan comes together in a slightly unhinged way. Can represent overcorrecting into forced positivity, the 'I used my coping skill and now I'm feral about it' vibe, or chaotic excitement. The paws-toward-camera pose adds an endearing invasive quality.

name: cat eyes closed looking like meditation jpg

labels.description: Close-up of a white and tabby cat with eyes gently closed, chin slightly lifted, wearing a soft, blissful expression. No visible text. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: serene, content, blissful — like suppressed smug satisfaction or deep peace
labels.meaning: Functions as a reaction to successfully practicing a DBT skill (e.g., mindfulness, TIPP breathing, radical acceptance). Works as 'me after actually doing my coping skill' or 'achieving 10 seconds of inner peace.' Can also read as gentle smugness — 'I handled that with grace.' Ambiguously could also be 'ignoring the chaos on purpose.'

name: cat in shock and wet during bath

labels.description: A grey long-haired cat, visibly wet and matted from a bath, with enormous wide yellow eyes, mouth open in a small horrified gape, and wild stray whiskers pointing in all directions. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: pure shock, horror, overwhelm, feeling ambushed
labels.meaning: Ideal reaction to unexpected bad news, sudden emotional flooding, or being blindsided by a trigger. Works for 'when your therapist points out a pattern you didn't know you had,' 'when Monday hits,' or 'when someone asks how you're doing and you're NOT okay.' The wet fur adds a layer of 'I did not consent to this experience.'

name: cat leaning on table shocked face

labels.description: A black-and-white tuxedo cat resting its front paws on a wooden table, seated in a wooden chair, mouth slightly open showing lower teeth, eyes wide and round with a startled expression. A grey cushion is visible behind it. Indoor setting.
labels.emotion: startled, caught off guard, mildly scandalised, confused
labels.meaning: Works as 'me when someone says something I was not prepared for,' 'caught doing something I shouldn't,' or reacting to unexpected oversharing in group settings. The table-leaning pose also suggests 'I am trying to hold myself together while processing this information.' Slightly less intense than full panic — more 'wait, what?' energy.

labels.description: A brown tabby cat photographed straight-on with a low-angle, slightly upward tilt. Eyes are heavy-lidded and narrowed, expression is stoic and unimpressed, chin slightly raised. Very long wispy whiskers extend wide. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: unimpressed, stoic, quietly confident, mildly contemptuous — classic 'chad' expression
labels.meaning: Functions as a power-move reaction: 'me after setting a boundary,' 'radical acceptance but make it cool,' or 'I did not react impulsively and I look amazing.' Great for slides about opposite action or walking away from an argument. The heavy-lidded stare communicates effortless self-possession. Could ambiguously read as tired or judgmental depending on context.

labels.description: Close-up photo of a white cat with a transparent background. The cat's mouth is slightly open, eyes are half-lidded and narrowed, and its expression is flat and unimpressed. No visible text. Chin is slightly tucked, giving a 'double-chin' effect.
labels.emotion: Blank, confused, mildly offended disbelief — the 'huh?' face
labels.meaning: Reacts to something absurd, unexpected, or hard to process. The open-mouth blankness reads as 'did you just say that?' or 'I cannot compute this.' Good for moments of emotional overwhelm presented as dumb confusion, or when DBT skills feel completely foreign.

name: cat looking like on testosterona face like chad

labels.description: Close-up photo of a large orange tabby cat with a transparent background. The cat has a very wide, heavy jaw and thick neck giving a 'chad' physique impression. Eyes are narrowed and stern, whiskers prominent, expression is stoic and dominant. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Stoic, unbothered, supremely confident — the 'chad' face
labels.meaning: Represents peak self-assurance, radical acceptance with swagger, or successfully not reacting to provocation. Can be used humorously when someone uses a DBT skill correctly or when choosing not to engage with drama. Ambiguously could also read as grumpy or judgmental depending on context.

labels.description: Low-resolution, slightly blurry close-up of a tan/beige cat (possibly a puma-like large cat or a domestic cat with a wide flat face) with a transparent-ish background. Eyes are heavy-lidded and downcast, cheeks are puffed slightly, mouth is closed with a subtle downward pull — the expression strongly suggests a slow, resigned exhale. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Weary, resigned, quietly exhausted — the long sigh
labels.meaning: Captures the feeling of tired acceptance or low-grade exasperation — not dramatic, just done. Useful for 'here we go again,' 'I tried my best,' or 'this is fine I guess' moments. Fits situations involving repeated frustration, practicing distress tolerance for the tenth time, or accepting imperfection. The blurriness adds to the deflated energy.

labels.description: Close-up front-facing photo of a tabby cat with green eyes, heavy-lidded drooping eyelids, and a neutral-to-downturned mouth expression, cut out against a white background. A small mute-speaker icon is visible in the bottom-right corner.
labels.emotion: Low-grade melancholy, unimpressed, mildly dissatisfied — not devastated, just quietly done with everything
labels.meaning: Conveys that 'slightly off' feeling where nothing is catastrophically wrong but motivation or joy is simply absent. Works as a relatable reaction to low-energy days, minor disappointments, or the baseline 'meh' state. The heavy-lidded look reads as emotionally depleted rather than furious.

labels.description: Chubby orange-and-white tabby cat sitting with both front paws tucked under its body, eyes almost completely shut in a contented squint, pink nose, and a soft rounded chin creating an impression of a pleased smile.
labels.emotion: Blissful contentment, quiet happiness, serene satisfaction
labels.meaning: The classic 'loaf cat with happy squint' signals cozy joy, self-satisfaction, or peaceful acceptance. Useful for moments of small wins, self-care success, comfort activities, or after using a coping skill that actually worked.

name: cat standing view super close looking into camera from the top

labels.description: Extreme close-up of a tabby cat's face shot from directly above and slightly in front, so the cat appears to be staring down the camera lens with one large, intense eye dominating the frame. labels.emotion: Intense curiosity, mild alarm, overwhelming nosiness, or confrontational staring
labels.meaning: The dramatic top-down angle makes the cat look like it is aggressively investigating something or invading personal space. labels.description: Grey tabby cat photographed straight-on, sitting upright with ears slightly back, eyes narrowed into a hard glare, and brow furrowed into a deep scowl. The image is somewhat grainy and the right side of the cat's face is lit with a warm orange-red tone.
labels.emotion: Fierce anger, intense displeasure, seething irritation
labels.meaning: One of the strongest 'angry cat' reaction images — the furrowed brow and hard stare read as genuine fury rather than mild annoyance. Suitable for moments of frustration, feeling wronged, or the emotion of anger in DBT contexts (e.g., illustrating the 'anger' emotion before discussing regulation skills). The dramatic red-orange lighting amplifies the intensity.

name: cat super close to camera wide eyes

labels.emotion: Startled, intensely curious, manic alertness
labels.meaning: Used to react to something overwhelming, surprising, or anxiety-inducing — the distorted proximity amplifies the sense of 'too much, too close, too fast.' Works well for moments of sudden panic, overstimulation, or hyperfocus on a problem.

labels.description: An orange/ginger tabby cat photographed from a low angle looking down at the camera with half-lidded, slightly narrowed dark eyes and a relaxed posture. One paw is partially visible. No visible text. White/transparent background.
labels.emotion: Smug, self-assured, unbothered, mildly judgmental
labels.meaning: Conveys quiet confidence or low-key superiority — the 'I've got this' or 'I know something you don't' energy. Suits moments of setting a boundary calmly, choosing not to engage with drama, or representing the 'wise/regulated self' in a carousel.

labels.description: A fluffy grey-and-white tabby cat with one eye closed in a wink and its long pink tongue extended fully out of its mouth. The cat's body is slightly rotated. No visible text. White/transparent background.
labels.emotion: Playful, goofy, silly, carefree
labels.meaning: Classic 'I'm having fun and I don't care how I look' reaction. Good for lighthearted self-deprecating moments, celebrating small wins in a silly way, or representing the 'opposite action' skill when choosing joy over rumination.

labels.description: A grey-and-white tabby cat photographed straight-on with very large, round, wide-open eyes staring directly into the camera. The expression is symmetrical and intensely focused. No visible text. Appears as a GIF (looping animation likely). White/transparent background.
labels.emotion: Shocked, frozen, deer-in-headlights, anxious alertness
labels.meaning: The classic 'staring blankly in disbelief or anxiety' reaction. Suits moments of receiving unexpected news, freezing when overwhelmed, or the 'what just happened' feeling. More composed than a22b72e0 — less manic, more stunned stillness.

labels.description: Close-up of a grey-and-white fluffy cat wearing a hand-crocheted green frog hat with two large bulging eyes on top. labels.emotion: Deeply unimpressed, heavy-lidded, vaguely suspicious — classic 'done with everything' cat face
labels.meaning: The absurd costume paired with the cat's utter disdain creates a 'I am being forced to participate in something ridiculous and I hate it' reaction meme. Works as a joke about being dragged into activities, therapy homework, group events, or any situation where you show up but make no effort to hide your reluctance.

labels.description: Close-up of an orange tabby cat with dramatically long, thick false eyelashes digitally added over its eyes. The cat stares directly into the camera with a slightly upward, deadpan gaze. No visible text. White background.
labels.emotion: Deadpan, vaguely judgmental, poker-faced with an air of unearned glamour
labels.meaning: The contrast between glamorous lashes and the cat's completely blank expression is the joke — functioning as a 'I dressed up / made an effort but feel nothing inside' or 'unbothered and gorgeous' reaction. Suits moments of ironic self-care, putting on a face for the world while internally flat, or sarcastically claiming confidence.

name: cat with loading circle on forehead

labels.description: A black cat photographed mid-motion with one paw raised, body slightly twisted. A digital loading spinner (circular dashed wheel, like a computer buffering icon) is overlaid on the cat's forehead between its bright yellow-green eyes. No visible text. White background.
labels.emotion: Wide-eyed, mid-action, slightly frantic — but the loading symbol implies frozen or buffering
labels.meaning: The loading spinner on the forehead is a classic 'brain not responding / still processing' joke. Ideal for moments of overwhelm, dissociation, decision fatigue, or when someone asks a question and the mind just goes blank. Ambiguously could also read as 'about to do something chaotic but lagging first.'

name: depressed looking cat with milkshake in hand

labels.description: A cream/white cat with dark markings around the eyes giving a naturally downturned, weary expression, sipping from a straw in a clear cup that appears to contain a milkshake or bubble tea. labels.emotion: Profoundly sad, tired, resigned — yet still drinking the milkshake
labels.meaning: The combination of miserable expression and self-soothing treat is the heart of the joke: 'I am suffering but I will have my little drink.' Functions as a relatable reaction to coping through small pleasures, sad-but-treating-yourself energy, or 'this is fine' moments. Highly versatile for DBT self-soothe skill slides. The supporting human hand adds a nurturing or enabling layer — ambiguously caring or enabling depending on context.

name: disturbed looking cat like freshly woken up

labels.emotion: Disturbed, startled, vaguely unhinged — like something alarming was just witnessed or the kitten was abruptly woken up
labels.meaning: Reaction meme for being rudely awakened, overstimulated, or confronted with something deeply unwelcome before being ready. Works as 'me when my alarm goes off' or 'me when someone talks to me before coffee.' Can also represent sensory overwhelm or morning dysregulation humor.

labels.meaning: Reaction meme for jaw-dropping news, sudden realizations, or anything that triggers an immediate 'WHAT' response. Suits carousel slides about unexpected emotional reactions, crisis moments, or the feeling when a thought spiral hits out of nowhere.

labels.emotion: Anxious, fearful, deer-in-headlights — quietly panicking while looking to something above or beyond
labels.meaning: Reaction meme for quiet dread, anticipatory anxiety, or the moment before something goes wrong. Suits slides about anxiety spirals, catastrophizing, or watching a situation escalate. The upward gaze adds a 'waiting for the other shoe to drop' quality. Filename says grumpy but expression reads more scared/dissociated.

labels.description: Adult orange tabby cat photographed from a low angle with both front paws stretched wide toward the camera, mimicking a selfie pose. Cat has a calm, slightly smug, direct gaze. Transparent background, no visible text. Full chest and outstretched legs visible.
labels.emotion: Confident, self-satisfied, unbothered — radiating a relaxed 'I've got this' or 'look at me' energy
labels.meaning: Humor meme for self-care wins, boundary-setting victories, or moments of unexpected confidence. Works as 'me after one (1) productive day' or 'treating myself like the main character.' Can represent healthy self-compassion humor in DBT contexts — celebrating small wins or radical acceptance moments.

name: sad cat meme transparent free png

labels.description: Cropped head of a white/grey cat on a near-transparent background. Eyes are gently closed or half-closed, mouth slightly open in a soft, content expression. No visible text.

labels.emotion: earnest, attentive, slightly urgent
labels.meaning: Classic 'tapping the watch' meme — used to signal that it is time for something, a deadline is approaching, or urging someone not to forget an obligation. Suitable for reminders about DBT skills practice, appointments, medication, coping strategies that need to be used now.

labels.description: An orange-and-white tabby cat sits upright on a white background. A disembodied human hand extends from the left holding a silver handheld microphone toward the cat's face. labels.meaning: The 'mic is shoved in your face' reaction meme — used to humorously represent being put on the spot, asked to explain yourself, or pressured to respond to something. Works as a reaction to being called out or unexpectedly interviewed about feelings/behaviour.

labels.description: A tabby cat wearing a red collar stands in a dynamic action pose, arms raised, appearing to slam or throw a large red UNO reverse card that is motion-blurred and glowing. labels.emotion: Determined, defiant, triumphant
labels.meaning: The 'UNO reverse card' meme — used to humorously deflect criticism, blame, or a bad situation back onto whoever sent it. Suitable for 'no, YOU deal with this' or 'right back at you' moments, self-advocacy humour, or refusing to accept guilt.

labels.description: A dark black cat sits facing forward with a serious, slightly judgmental expression and wide green eyes. Above its head is a drawn loading/buffering spinner icon (white radiating dashes in a circle), suggesting a thought in progress. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Blank, processing, mildly bewildered
labels.meaning: The 'buffering' or 'loading' reaction meme — represents being so overwhelmed, confused, or emotionally overloaded that the brain has frozen mid-thought. Useful for moments of information overload, emotional dysregulation, or simply having no words.

labels.emotion: Possessive, smug, protective (orange cat); resigned, sleepy (grey cat)
labels.meaning: The 'I will not let go / this is mine now' holding meme — used to represent clinging to something (a comfort, a person, a coping mechanism) or the humour of being overly attached. labels.description: Extreme close-up of a light-grey tabby cat's face filling the entire frame. Works as a reaction to overthinking, analysis paralysis, or when a situation feels impossibly complicated. Can humorously illustrate the DBT concept of being in 'emotion mind' chaos or hitting cognitive overload.

labels.description: Close-up photo of a light-tan cat staring directly into the camera with a flat, deadpan expression. labels.meaning: Used as a reaction to something surprising, rude, or absurd — the cat's unblinking stare paired with the misspelled 'Excuse me?' signals disbelief or mild indignation in a humorous way. Suitable for moments when a boundary has been nudged, something unexpected was said, or when reacting to a ridiculous situation with dramatic faux-outrage.

labels.description: A grey-and-white cat wearing an oversized dark-pink/mauve baseball cap tilted forward, holding a bouquet of pink tulips. The cat's tongue is slightly out, giving a sweet, earnest expression. A small sparkle/star sticker appears near the lower right. White sticker-cut background.
labels.emotion: Sweet, bashful, affectionate, earnest
labels.meaning: Functions as a wholesome gesture of kindness or apology — the cat offering flowers while looking cute and slightly sheepish reads as 'here, this is for you' or 'please don't be mad.' Ideal for moments of making up after conflict, expressing appreciation, celebrating a friend, or softening difficult conversations with warmth and humor.

labels.description: A tabby kitten with a soft, hopeful, slightly sad expression looks toward the viewer. labels.emotion: Hopeful, tender, slightly nervous, earnest
labels.meaning: A gentle, slightly awkward offering of affection or peace — the contrast between the soft kitten and the chunky emoji hand adds gentle absurdist humor. The mismatch of realistic cat and emoji prop makes it endearingly clumsy rather than grand.

labels.description: A small orange-and-white kitten standing upright on its hind legs, body twisted and craned dramatically backward/upward as if straining or recoiling. No visible text. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: Strained, startled, dramatically overwhelmed
labels.meaning: Captures the feeling of physically recoiling from something shocking, exhausting, or too much to handle — a comedic 'nope,' 'I can't,' or 'this is too much for me' reaction. Suitable for moments of overwhelm, avoidance urges, or when distress tolerance feels impossible.

labels.description: A fluffy cream-and-peach coloured cat with narrowed, stern eyes and a furrowed brow gazes directly forward with a grumpy expression. labels.description: A cat's face photoshopped onto a banana costume, standing upright on small legs. Two large blue cartoon tear-arc arrows curve outward and downward from each side of the face, exaggerating crying. No visible text. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: Ugly-crying, deeply distressed, dramatically sad
labels.meaning: The 'banana cat crying' meme — represents intense, over-the-top emotional crying, often used humorously to acknowledge big feelings that may feel disproportionate. Useful for slides about emotional intensity, validation of big emotions, or self-compassionate humor about crying spells.

labels.description: A cat lying in bed with head on a pillow and body tucked under a white fluffy blanket. Transparent background.
labels.emotion: Forced cheerfulness, unsettling fake happiness, manic grin
labels.meaning: Represents masking distress with an exaggerated smile — the 'I'm fine' face when you are decidedly not fine, or the slightly unhinged cheerfulness of dissociation/people-pleasing. labels.description: A cat's face digitally composited onto a banana costume character standing upright on small legs. The cat has an exaggerated scrunched, grimacing expression with large animated blue tear streams shooting outward dramatically from both eyes. No visible text. White background.
labels.emotion: Dramatic, simultaneous crying and grumpiness — the 'crying but also angry about it' face

Good for carousel slides about emotion dysregulation, riding the wave, or 'this is fine' moments that are clearly not fine. labels.description: Close-up of a Scottish Fold cat's face wrapped snugly in a fluffy white towel or blanket, white background, no visible text. Only the face and the top of the wrap are visible.
labels.emotion: Deadpan, slightly suspicious, unimpressed — wide dark eyes staring directly at the camera with a flat, stoic expression.
labels.meaning: Functions as a 'just got out of the bath and I'm judging everything' or 'cozy but still done with you' reaction. Works for moments of reluctant self-care, post-cry wrap-up, or being dragged into doing something wellness-related while maintaining zero enthusiasm.

labels.meaning: Conveys low-key shame, guilt, or the feeling of being unable to face the world. Works as a reaction to minor embarrassment, a mistake, or that heavy 'I can't look anyone in the eye' sensation. The added tear sticker amplifies sadness without being dramatic.

labels.description: A fluffy golden/cream kitten tucked snugly into a soft pink blanket or sleeping bag, paws peeking out over the edge. It wears a small pink bow on top of its head. labels.emotion: Cosy but wistful; soft sadness with a hint of 'please leave me here forever'
labels.meaning: Perfect for 'comfort cocoon' moments — cancelling plans to stay in bed, self-soothing days, or the bittersweet feeling of being safe but still a little sad. The bow adds a self-aware cuteness that keeps the mood gentle rather than heavy. Suits slides about rest, self-care, or low-spoon days.

labels.description: A white/light grey cat wrapped tightly in a large grey fleece blanket pulled up over its head like a hood, with only its face visible. The cat has prominent, glistening teary eyes and a slightly scrunched, woeful expression. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Full-on devastated; overwhelmed, vulnerable, hiding from the world
labels.meaning: The iconic 'crying cat in blanket' meme. Signals emotional overwhelm, a hard cry session, or the urge to completely withdraw and be held by soft fabric. Ideal for slides about emotional flooding, distress tolerance, or the very relatable urge to wrap yourself up and disappear for a while. One of the most widely recognised sad-cat reaction images.

labels.description: Close-up of a tabby kitten's face, streaked with tears running down both cheeks. Its mouth is slightly open showing teeth, expression caught between a cry and a wail — visibly distressed. Dark, slightly blurred background; cut-out style on white. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Actively crying and distressed; raw, open emotional pain
labels.meaning: Represents that moment when you're not quietly sad but actually mid-cry and can't stop. The open mouth suggests audible crying or trying to hold it together and failing. Useful for slides about emotion regulation, the peak of an emotion wave, or normalising big feelings. More intense than the blanket cat; suits 'it hit different today' contexts.

labels.description: A large orange-and-white cat photographed close-up, holding a modern black smartphone (multi-lens camera visible) toward its face with a human hand. A lit cigarette dangles from the cat's mouth with a small wisp of smoke. Expression is heavy-lidded, deadpan, and world-weary. No visible text. White background.
labels.emotion: Deadpan, unbothered, world-weary, too-tired-to-care cool
labels.meaning: Functions as a reaction image for 'I have seen things' exhaustion, stress-scrolling, or coping with stress in less-than-ideal ways. The cigarette and phone together suggest 'bad coping habits but make it look cool.' Suitable for carousel slides about unhelpful coping strategies, distraction, or the humor in recognizing our own maladaptive habits without judgment. Ambiguity: cigarette may reference stress/coping symbolically or simply reads as absurd cat humor; context will determine tone.

labels.description: A grey-and-white cat photographed on a white background, holding a small kitchen knife upright in one paw. The cat has wide dark eyes and its mouth is slightly open in a subtle, unsettling grin. No visible text. Cut-out sticker style with no background.
labels.emotion: Menacing yet oddly cute; scheming, mildly threatening grin
labels.meaning: Classic 'knife cat' meme used to express low-key petty menace, passive aggression, or hyperbolic frustration—e.g., when someone is annoying you but you're still functioning. Works as a humorous reaction to urges to 'fight back' against life stressors, suitable for slides about coping with irritation or the urge to act out (with the joke defusing the intensity).

labels.description: An orange tabby cat wearing a red collar stands upright on its hind legs with one paw raised and extended forward in a presenting or 'look at this' gesture. A large pink rubber flip-flop (thong sandal) is positioned prominently in the foreground to the cat's left, roughly the same size as the cat, as if the cat is displaying or threatening with it. White background.
labels.emotion: assertive, threatening (playfully), presenting
labels.meaning: The flip-flop is a widely understood cultural symbol of parental/authority discipline (a slipper threat). The cat presenting it humorously signals 'don't test me' or 'consequences are coming.' Useful for joking about setting limits, consequences of crossing boundaries, or the moment you decide to finally enforce a rule.

labels.description: A white or very light cream-coloured cat photographed on a white background, sitting upright and raising both front paws toward the viewer. The image has been digitally edited so both paws appear to be displaying extended middle fingers (rude gesture). The cat's expression is calm, slightly downward-gazing, almost unbothered. No visible text. Cut-out sticker style.
labels.emotion: Unbothered, dismissive, coolly defiant
labels.meaning: Used to humorously express 'I don't care' or rejection of an unwanted demand, boundary-crossing, or annoying situation. In a DBT context this could accompany slides about setting limits, resisting pressure, or the feeling of wanting to tell the world off—with the absurdity of the cat doing it softening the edge into comedy rather than genuine hostility.

labels.description: A tabby-and-white cat wearing a plush grey shark costume hoodie; the shark's open mouth frames the cat's face, showing rows of white teeth and two cartoon eyes on top. The cat's own face is visible inside, with a distinctly grumpy, furrowed-brow scowl. White sticker border around the whole image. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Grumpy, stoic, unamused despite ridiculous costume
labels.meaning: Combines cuteness with grumpiness and a mild 'danger' theme (shark). Works as a reaction image for feeling absurdly out of place, being forced into situations you didn't sign up for, or maintaining a sour mood even when things should be fun. Suitable for carousel slides about masking emotions, feeling like a danger to yourself in a silly self-aware way, or tolerating distressing situations with dark humour.

labels.description: A cream-and-orange coloured cat sits upright with both front legs raised high above its head, paws outstretched. Large animated tears stream down both cheeks and its mouth is wide open in an expression of wailing or desperate pleading. Two yellow cartoon/emoji-style hands with fingers spread (jazz-hands or beseeching gesture) are superimposed at the top of each of the cat's raised arms. White background.
labels.emotion: desperate, pleading, dramatically distressed, wailing
labels.meaning: Embodies over-the-top emotional desperation or theatrical begging. Functions as a relatable exaggeration of moments when emotions feel overwhelming or when you really, really want something. Suitable for slides about emotional intensity, drama, or the urge to plead with the universe. The jazz-hands emoji arms add absurdist humour to genuine distress.

labels.description: Close-up of a golden/orange tabby cat with one paw raised and pressed against the side of its head, as if rubbing its temple or doing a facepalm. Eyes are wide open and slightly worried-looking. White background, no visible text.
labels.emotion: exasperated, stressed, overwhelmed, facepalm
labels.meaning: Functions as a 'why is this happening / I can't even / facepalm' reaction. Classic visual shorthand for secondhand embarrassment, exhaustion with a situation, or mild existential despair. Suitable for moments when something is too much to process.

labels.description: White/cream fluffy cat with eyes gently closed, wearing an oversized digitally-added pair of red glossy human lips puckered for a kiss. A yellow cartoon hand emoji and a pink heart emoji are overlaid on the left cheek area. No visible text.
labels.emotion: affectionate, blissful, playful, loving
labels.meaning: Functions as an over-the-top affectionate or 'sending love/kisses' reaction. The absurdly large lips make it comedic rather than sincere, so it works for playful declarations of love, self-care affirmations ('I love myself'), or sarcastically sweet moments. Ambiguously could also read as a 'mwah, deal with it' energy.

labels.description: Orange tabby cat with wide glossy eyes and a broad smile, with four small pink cartoon arrow stickers pointing inward toward its face from the cheeks and lower jaw area, plus two beige cartoon finger-pointing emoji hands pointing upward toward the cat's chin/face. No visible text.
labels.emotion: proud, self-satisfied, presenting itself, gleeful
labels.meaning: Functions as a 'presenting myself / look at this / this guy right here' reaction. Commonly used for self-promotion, humble-bragging, or cheerfully owning something about yourself. The pointing arrows and hands emphasize 'look at me!' energy. Can also work as supportive pointing at someone else's achievement.

labels.description: White and orange tabby cat sitting upright with eyes gently closed and one paw raised to its mouth/chin in a thoughtful, smug, or suppressed-laughter pose — similar to a 'stifling a laugh' or 'hmm, very interesting' gesture. Relaxed, slightly self-satisfied posture. No visible text.
labels.emotion: smug, amused, contemplative, suppressing a laugh
labels.meaning: Functions as a 'trying not to laugh / I said what I said / quietly judging' reaction. The closed eyes and paw-to-mouth pose read as either restrained amusement or serene smugness. Suitable for moments of quiet satisfaction, holding back laughter at someone's situation, or 'not my problem' detachment.

labels.description: A slim brown-and-white cat with oversized pink anime-blush marks on both cheeks, looking slightly upward with a soft shy expression. Two yellow pointing-finger emoji hands are overlaid on the body, both index fingers pointing toward each other at chest level. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Shy, bashful, self-conscious, gently pleading
labels.meaning: Classic 'nervous asking for a favour' or 'uwu it was me, sorry' meme pose. The inward-pointing fingers signal timid self-reference — 'this person right here' said with embarrassment. Works as a reaction to admitting something awkward, asking for reassurance, or owning up to a small mistake in a cute, disarming way.

labels.description: A white-and-grey tabby cat with wide, round surprised eyes and mouth dropped open, caught mid-exclamation. Background removed, leaving a rough-cut transparent silhouette. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Shocked, startled, caught off-guard — despite the filename suggesting 'straight face', the actual expression is clearly open-mouthed surprise
labels.meaning: Ironic reaction image for moments of genuine disbelief or mock-outrage — 'did that really just happen?' The gap between the filename label ('straight face') and the obviously shocked expression can itself be used as a joke about denial or underreaction. Suits sudden plot twists, unexpected news, or reacting to something wild someone just said.

labels.description: Close-up of a drenched orange tabby cat with flat, wet fur clinging to its face. Eyes are heavily dilated and half-lidded, giving a deadpan, deeply unimpressed stare directly at the camera. No visible text.
labels.emotion: Annoyed, done with everything, dead inside, seething quietly
labels.meaning: Iconic 'wet cat' meme used to express maximum suffering and zero enthusiasm. Works as a reaction to being inconvenienced, hit with unexpected bad news, forced into something unpleasant, or simply existing on a hard day. Highly relatable for DBT contexts around tolerating distress — 'I am enduring this.'

labels.description: A round-faced white-and-grey tabby cat with soft brown eyes and a small, closed, subtly upturned mouth suggesting a gentle smile. The face is slightly squished and oversized relative to the neck, giving a plush toy quality. No visible text and no literal thumbs-up visible — the thumbs-up framing is likely the cultural read of its pleased expression.
labels.emotion: Quietly pleased, content, gently approving, wholesome
labels.meaning: A soft, affirming reaction — 'okay, that's fine by me' or 'good job.' The understated smile reads as sincere encouragement without being over the top. Useful in carousel slides for validating effort, celebrating small wins, or ending on a warm note. The plush-like appearance adds comfort and safety.
